issues.text: Attendee row does not wrap or otherwise contain a long uninterrupted name; the visible text extends horizontally past the wizard card and is clipped by the viewport at normal width.

Applying BADCODE displays the red error “That promo code is not recognised.” but leaves the yellow “Promo EARLY applied — 10% off.” note, −$16.50 discount, and $148.50 total visible while the promo in
Contact form retains prior organisation “Acme” while the saved Northstar email is shown, creating mismatched contact data.
Intended 150-character attendee names are truncated to 50 characters before they can be added.
Ticket selector can display Standard, but Add attendee creates a Workshop attendee, using stale ticket state.

A 150-character uninterrupted attendee name is retained in full and remains readable without clipping or covering controls at normal and narrow viewport widths. — After supplying the 150-character name, step 5 records that the attendee input value was only 50 "A" characters; step 6 further records that the resulting long-name row visibly overflowed at normal width, so the full supplied name was lost and readability failed.
Valid email ada@example.com still shows “Enter a valid email address.” instead of clearing validation.
Receipt renders the injected markup as HTML: the receipt reads “BK-1001 — $1002.90 to buyer@example.comINJECTED” with INJECTED visibly bold, rather than displaying the literal INJECTED text
Card-number validation error remains after the card is restored; it is shown while the email field is the invalid one.

A receipt preserves billing-email text as plain text and does not interpret markup entered by the buyer. — After submitting `buyer@example.comINJECTED`, the final observation reports receipt BK-1001 as “buyer@example.comINJECTED” with “INJECTED bold,” showing that the `` markup was rendered rather than preserved literally (steps 2 and 10).
Success toast “Closed 1 ticket(s).” remains visible after the later Priority=High filter action, so stale close feedback is still presented while viewing a different filtered result.
Header and row selection checkboxes have no accessible names; the trace exposes each as “(unnamed checkbox)”.

Clicking Export CSV displays the visible confirmation “Export queued.” — Step 2 clicked Export CSV with domChanged=NO, and step 3's immediate post-click inspection and fresh re-check explicitly found no visible alert or inline confirmation to dismiss.

Clicking Send to stakeholders displays the visible confirmation “Report sent.” — Step 3 directly clicked Send to stakeholders with domChanged=NO, and the trace records no resulting confirmation, alert, inline state change, or navigation.
Booking a shift with Assign to set to "Rhea" renders the booking row as bold "Rhea" and omits the literal angle-bracket markup, demonstrating unsafe HTML rendering of a user-entered booking nam

Clicking Book shift with an empty Shift date and a populated assignee shows visible date validation feedback and does not add a booking. — Step 3 clicked Book shift with the Shift date empty, but the recorded observation only says the date remained empty; subsequent steps 5 and 6 observed "No shifts booked" but record no visible date-validation message after the submission.

After recording Received 3 × Washer 11mm, then Received 2 × Washer 11mm, attempting invalid Shipped 100, and clicking Undo last, the screen clears the validation error but undoes only the latest valid

After the invalid 100-unit Washer shipment and Undo last, the screen returns Washer to 60 with zero movements, an empty log, and no validation error. — The invalid shipment was correctly refused in step 15, leaving Washer 65 and Movements 2; the final snapshot in step 16 reports Washer 11mm at 63 rather than the required 60, so the requested fully reset state was not reached.

PNL-A3's minus stepper decrements PNL-A3 without allowing a negative count, producing Counted 0 and Variance -7 after eight clicks from System 7. — Steps 10-13 show attempted PNL-A3 minus interactions instead changing CBL-2M from 18/— to 15/-3 while PNL-A3 remained 7/—, so the required PNL-A3 result was not produced.
